pages.text: If you use a spindle to deal damage, it will become a bloody spindle, and maintain a Sympathetic link to the mob it injured.$(br)If a bound mob is influencing a Fate hallow which influences this spindle, any healing or harm the bound mob receives will be divided between itself and the linked mob.

Odd amounts will be randomly rounded up or down. Each point of health gained or lost through this Sympathetic connection costs one fate spirit from the hallow.$(br2)This Practice only works if the target mob is in a loaded chunk.$(br2)A player can be substituted for either part of this setup using their Self in a chalk circle.
